parsedVerdict.reasoning: The Employee class lives in the business layer, which is a domain layer. Its overtimeEligible() method is a business rule and belongs there. But the class is also marked with the TypeORM decorators @Entity() and @Column(). Those decorators map the class to database tables and columns, so ORM persistence mapping sits inside the domain model. That mapping belongs to the persistence layer, which is infrastructure. The typeorm import edge itself is out of scope, since import direction is checked elsewhere. The failure here is the persistence mapping in the class, which the rubric names as a misplaced responsibility.
